notes.title: Preview Update #13
notes.content:
[h3]Language[/h3]

It's been a long time since the last update. The main reason for this update is to add a lot of different languages to the game. With the upcoming Update #13 there will be 40 supported languages in the game: 
[list]
[*] Afrikaans
[*] Arabic
[*] Basque
[*] Belarusian
[*] Bulgarian
[*] Catalan
[*] Chinese (Simplified)
[*] Chinese (Traditional)
[*] Czech
[*] Danish
[*] Dutch
[*] English
[*] Estonian
[*] Finnish
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Greek
[*] Hebrew
[*] Hungarian
[*] Icelandic
[*] Indonesian
[*] Italian
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] Latvian
[*] Lithuanian
[*] Norwegian
[*] Polish
[*] Portuguese
[*] Romanian
[*] Russian
[*] Serb-Croatian
[*] Slovak
[*] Slovenian
[*] Spanish
[*] Swedish
[*] Thai
[*] Turkish
[*] Ukrainian
[*] Vietnamese
[/list]

However, as I used a translator and I am not capable to spell check all of these languages there will be most certainly errors. So please report them with a screenshot and the correct translation, if you find one. I will correct that as quick as possible.

With the added languages there are also new fonts added to the game to support more characters for special player names for the leaderboard.

Moreover, hints will be resized more strictly to avoid reaching the end of the screen. This will increase the readability for all languages and screen sizes.

Also music titles will not be translated anymore. This means they will keep their original song name.


[h3]Music[/h3]

Speaking of music, I added 8 new music tracks to the game:
[list]
[*] Dandelion
[*] Hope
[*] Hopeful
[*] Light
[*] Mastered
[*] New Day
[*] Silent
[*] Sunshine
[/list]

There are now 25 different songs in the game you can choose from. To listen to the new songs you have to activate them on the "Options Cube" under "Audio" and "Music Tracks".


[h3]Ambient[/h3]

I also added 9 new ambient tracks to the game:
[list]
[*] Birds #2
[*] Branches
[*] Calm Wind
[*] Cemetery
[*] Desert
[*] Jungle
[*] Savannah
[*] Sea Storm
[*] Tundra
[/list]

There are now 25 different ambient sounds in the game you can choose from. The same as for the music, to listen to the new ambient sounds you have to activate them on the "Options Cube" under "Audio" and "Ambient Tracks".


[h3]Medieval Village Background[/h3]

Beside that, I also added a new interactable background to the game. With it there are now 25 different backgrounds you can choose from. It's called "Village" and represents a medieval village. You can turn each torch individually on or off with the left mouse button or all at once with the right mouse button. Depending on your lighting and visual effect setting it can achieve different kind of atmospheres:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/669c777123b2df82e8e31d7f647ec7666383697a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/b30baa831a6e567d928c9d23b715bfd5742a0082.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/db00ec796f258af2cca4542eae11163690098996.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/2612feae71b65826d642cabb1c03b3e09dd5320b.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/57f9a55c773abb2f6b258ba38e2dcdd91ec49441.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/b324329c608f40ed9c9530927f49108d1fd0bceb.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/0347447b72eab439b93df1f0a93d01cf6cdaf32c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/edd3f9f8c62e078cd80f9e578996c1e169514c79.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/a7b3e34d99dadcda2bc2abfca4d8d7edf2fbf4ba.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/2647fb50adbc496e79d1c406ee24b662970c4b94.png[/img][/url]


[h3]Lighting Moods[/h3]

Moreover, I added two new lighting moods to the game, which means that there are now also 25 different lighting moods in the game. The first one "Blue Sky" exposes every scene with a bright light and a god-ray effect.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/fb63a615892f1115b78530ad38224f50b6ceb5ed.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/c39f2b5525d5a7439993425dcc99a43fbb52f52d.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/b7ae5844d4757186d5728e3e9328147dadbe8759.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/ca63f7377df460e00cbcd2e83d9a20a9fa66a3eb.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/c5c6939f1c546c8757f1f84b4a2c5d68f1e8b84d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/9cb10972ac6978a7558051b80ecfce14f0609029.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/7376251634a8a1d6fe757524d04c9683e94980de.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/b61f3d9cc33f7aa771d6065ee7c271864575190a.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/8ecc638fdf3b426251c5d325f27c3eea64f06b72.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/945ddca93f34c73b15ea426131092301675f1bd4.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/47040cd61a1ae98031c8998551f5f4c25f87bc4c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/711d1c0245e00f2a3c8932b9f122087482b455a3.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/260ff5e8c411344521e6925ea45ff49e617e5c97.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/4fa2e2b4f3b1ee4ff9324fbd7e922a7299ab0952.png[/img][/url]

The second one "Darkness" does the complete opposite. There are no lights anymore. Use this if you don't like to be distracted or if only the scenery itself should illuminate the scene. Further, "Darkness" lets you embrace the visual effects even more. However, as it makes it very hard to see the matrix blocks and solve any matrix, I recommend to use the self-illuminating "Neon" blocks with it.

[h3]Visual Effects[/h3]

There are also two new visual effects, which brings them also, and you probably guessed it now, to 25 visual effects you can choose from. The first one is called "Meteorite" and it will let rain meteorites from the sky, which will collide with the scene, explode and shatter into small pieces. It is also interactable and you can try to click a meteorite during the flight to let it explode in air. 

Why a meteorite shower in a calm riddle game? You should ask [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198078498143]Wyvern-of-the-Rising-Sun[/url] as he suggested it.

The second visual effect was also suggested by him. A "Dragon" with 7 balls floating around. The dragon and his balls (no pun intended) are interactable and will react to your actions.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/170898848152a16f0cf1d7a6b89f35c70e94243d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/692fe8b291250b1342f1294e5ef2b009834daa3b.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/d9b7d37e1d2c2a54f08d88e95ef3f7f40342b6d8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/1ec263c99ad184c80036cda25d615448a0c818e1.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/ecf5e0e15874434433b315d1e9770c757c5263e1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/b8cb1a85138ae5df50998bc0eea44a0cba1b1bae.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/8c5fdb01b43ba185f6bd9e18146493492095cbb1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/2888088ad82dc828f82fd35de87a685047f05b37.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/433cab4c196465945ea46fe9f50ce1a80eef7191.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/673af93a659b297a46e78c142e69faa2b15526de.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/1b55038455276f9c6c57ddeb69f7bb1ca846cb5d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/c226c92be94416b1f4ff7d85261950d2c37262fb.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/204776bb7874bb80a7b100863d8b4209023d5850.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/f978efe1b2a9f2e682db773044a718917cc07334.png[/img][/url]


[h3]Block Style[/h3]

To make everything complete, I also added two new block styles to the game, which brings them to 25 too. Actually, it is one block style with two variants. The block style "Leaf 1" will be without and "Leaf 2" with color and as the name suggested, it shows leaves with different counts.

notes.title: Preview Update #12 - Release
notes.content:
[h3]Release and Demo[/h3]

With the Update #12, which will be available at Friday 2nd July evening (CET), Matrix Brain Twister will leave Early Access and become a full release. This means the monthly update rhythm will be changed to an update on demand. So only if you or I find still some bugs or have a new idea which features I can add to the game, I will do that as quick as possible.

Moreover, the demo will be updated to the latest version too.

What is in the demo?
[list]
[*]random generated or empty 2D and 3D matrices with all different forms
[*]all ambient and button sounds as well as all music tracks
[*]all different cursor, block styles, lighting moods, backgrounds and visual effects
[/list]
What is NOT part of the demo?
[list]
[*]4D matrices
[*]600 handcrafted levels for 2D, 3D and 4D matrices
[*]save/load, achievements, progression, statistics, leaderboard
[*]Steam Workshop content
[/list]

[h3]Steam Workshop[/h3]

With the release, the Steam Workshop will be go online. This means you can create and upload custom content for "Ambient" and "Button" sounds, "Block Style" and "Cursor" images and also your own "Music".

The specific instructions on how to create custom content can be found at multiple places (in game, custom folder, Steam Workshop, Steam Forum). You can also download "Sample" content from the Steam Workshop to look how it should be done.

notes.content:

notes.title: Preview Update #8
notes.content:
[h3]MacOS and Linux[/h3]

With this update there will be versions for Mac and Linux user.

However, Linux user need to have the Vulkan API installed, otherwise the game will crash. So if you have the Vulkan API properly installed and the game still crashes for your Linux OS, you should refund the game for now.


[h3]Back-End Update[/h3]

I also updated the Unity Editor, its High Defintion Render Pipeline (HDRP) and Steamworks to the latest version. In addition to that I converted the game files from C# to C++ (Windows and Linux). All in all this update has a huge impact on the visuals, especially lighting, and performance.

Therefore, let me know in the Steam Forum, how your favourite scene now looks and performs (better or worse FPS, visual glitches, artifacts, low resolution shadows, etc.).


[h3]Volumetric Lighting[/h3]

Furthermore, due to this back-end update I changed the volumetric lighting effect for all scenes to reduce the low quallity noise. Moving light sources should also flicker less aggressively now.

In the graphic settings there is a new option to change the volumetric lighting quality (Low, Mid, High, Ultra). The performance impact depends on the choosen scene and can be between no (0 FPS) or mediocre (~10 FPS) gain/lost. 


[h3]Victorian Background[/h3]

The already existing victorian background gets three new view directions. So you can now have four different views in one background. Change the view by clicking on the street name sign on the left or right side. As before, all street lights can be turned on/off individual with a left click or all at once with a right click.

[h3]4D Levels[/h3]

Moreover, I added 30 new handcrafted levels and achievements for the 4D Octaplex 5x5x5x5 matrix. It looks intimidating at first, but is solvable for every intermediate riddler.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/ce7d8b0125b7f3425a958c37ed1d451ac655d748.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/5fb9e3eb4ef8bdc29fed0a4d7b2e4c162e072f38.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/97495621bf06471cc918cdf5487fe2700165fa9b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/06f258186190165568630aa67487d1390215eb65.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/58e3daa064da85b2c5fabb3e0164d158692487a9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/7e80ae9cbbce503a6d71077d7d88e962ee3c5034.png[/img][/url]


[h3]Custom Cursor[/h3]

With Update #6 it is also possible to create your own custom cursor. Just create three 512x512 png files named "Default.png", "Click.png" and "Drag.png". The click point is always in the center of the image. So make sure your cursor is pointing to the center.

Then create a folder in "Matrix Brain Twister/Matrix Brain Twister_Data/StreamingAssets/Custom/Cursor" with a name of your choice and put these png files into it. 

Then start the game and you will see your custom cursor at the style settings on the option cube.

[h3]Style Everywhere[/h3]

One last new feature is that you can now change the style of the game wherever you are. Just press one of the following buttons to change the assigned style.

C - Cursor
M - Matrix Block
L - Lighting Mood
V - VFX
B - Background

The bell tower also strikes on the hour as often as the hours have passed. Furthermore, you can turn on/off the street lights one by one with LMB or all at once with RMB.
